description:
.agent/docs/telemetry.md states 'Causality is DERIVED, never stored' as a standing principle. It was not one: it was fz-kdt.34's scope note -- 'without touching what emit sites pass or costing a telemetry-off run anything' -- which hardened into architecture when it reached the docs.

Replace it with what is true after this arc: the deciding component records its decision, a telemetry-off run still costs nothing, and the report reads rather than infers. Present tense, no narrative of the change.
title: Retire 'causality is derived, never stored' from the telemetry doc
